Yes, damaged items are handled differently than standard returns.

Damaged/incorrect items: We’re really sorry for the trouble. You’ll need to contact our Customer Service team first and provide photos/images of the issue via live chat or email. A claim must be approved before sending the item back, or we can’t refund related return shipping fees.

Normal returns: These are processed directly through our Returns Portal within 30 days. Return shipping fees are always deducted from your refund, and you don’t need to file a damage claim—just select your item, choose a return reason, and use the label we provide.

If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.
